description:
As a customer,

I want to remove an item from my shopping cart,

So that I can update my purchase before checkout.
h1. Business Requirement

Customers should be able to remove previously added products from their shopping cart and see the cart updated immediately.
----
h1. Description

The application shall allow users to remove products from the cart from both the Inventory page and Cart page.

The cart badge, cart contents, and product actions shall be updated accordingly.
----
h1. Preconditions
 * User is logged in.
 * At least one product exists in the shopping cart.
 * User is on the Inventory or Cart page.
